requirements.quote:
versions of QUIC that use Version Negotiation packets MUST define a
   mechanism that is robust against version downgrade attacks.
requirements.condition: A future version of QUIC uses Version Negotiation packets.
requirements.required_behavior: The QUIC version must define a mechanism that is robust against version downgrade attacks.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using Version Negotiation packets without defining a mechanism robust against version downgrade attacks.
requirements.why_checkable: The specification and implementation of a future QUIC version that uses Version Negotiation packets can be inspected and tested for a downgrade-resistant mechanism.
